[[File:Domesticatedmilk.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A container of domesticated milk]]
'''Milk''' was the nutrient fluid produced by the [[Breast/Legends|mammary glands]] of [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]].

==History==
[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]] drank [[Blue milk/Legends|blue milk]] with dinner after purchasing [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] often drank warm milk during her first pregnancy, to soothe her stomach.<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref>

On [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], the [[Queen Mother]] had a milk house from which servants got cream for the kitchens.<ref name="NJO DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>

The [[Solo family/Legends|Solo family]] also used milk to make [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]] from scratch, which she said tasted much better than the hot chocolate which came out of a dispenser. When [[Tesar Sebatyne]] sought an audience with [[Aryn Dro Thul|Madame Thul]], [[Raynar Thul]]'s mother, during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]], he asked for a glass of milk because it could stop him from drooling.<ref name="DNI TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
